Two limits keep the review's broader illustrations separate from demonstrated results.
The experiment distinguishes repeated presentations of one visible statement receipt;
different receipts or speakers are not proof of independent sources. Hidden common
sources, hearsay and trust remain conditional. Also, target-private commitment is
represented here, but the target's knowledge of its own commitment is not separately
tested. The review's self-knowledge corollary is a future capability, not a new witness.

rows.text:
LOCAL DISPOSITION — no owner ruling required. Starting counters802/0.
PHEN-SOCIAL-001 requires two observers, a target's private commitment, fallible
expression, a public outcome compatible with either commitment, and selective later
explanation/correction. Architecture9 requires observer-specific first-order models
and explicitly forbids direct target-truth access. Brief12.10/12.13/12.14 and North
Star's private-state/expression and distinct-observer requirements govern this intake.

rows.text:
P3-006 ports independent observer/target keys, permitted evidence, wrong inference,
correction and correlated reports. P3-007 retains trust/suspicion as future candidates;
no trust scalar is invented. P3-008's social affect, embarrassment and jealousy remain
future corpus obligations, not emotion labels added here. EXP-008 ports hidden-truth
noninterference. MEC-001/002/006 preserve evidence accumulation, last-observation,
unknown/zero and unavailable-evidence distinctions. MEC-004 supplies only the explicit
identity-establishing-channel control; ordinary recognition is not claimed. MEC-019
and MEC-020 preserve public outcome versus private commitment. MEC-012..018 reasons,
dice, expression and identity-learning controls remain unchanged; this observer
experiment ends at independent person-model probes. SUB trace, exact arithmetic,
counterfactuals and complete-prefix restoration remain mandatory.

rows.text:
ORD-002 needs an accepted bounded ordering contract before the first multi-character
fixture. Select snapshot fan-out: both observers probe prior state at40, a single
target source executes110, both independently project120 and learn140. No observer
reads the other's current or prior model. Disjoint ownership keys commute; swapping
observer processing order will be tested through semantic comparison. Reciprocal
same-instant decisions and simultaneous interaction conflicts remain outside scope.
This resolves a conservative bounded ordering choice locally, not ORD-002 globally.
